policy_aperture.aperture: Review the complete current revision as if no earlier review exists.
policy_aperture.changed_material_rule: All visible document material is in aperture.

acceptance_atoms.text: System trust material must be resolved before outbound catalogue fetch.
A missing trust bundle must be diagnosed before network dial.
Fallback attempts must preserve bounded diagnostics.

added_lines: Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.

Catalogue fetch resolves system trust material for outbound HTTPS. When no trust bundle is found, it attempts the network dial and diagnoses the bundle after TLS fails. Fallback logs the complete exception chain without a size limit.
